evidence.quote: And the transcript is the truth, because it exists.

observations.why: Stated as an absolute foundational axiom about ground-truth reality without hedging.

evidence.quote: The transcript is the truth. But then from there the perspective becomes a way to interrogate the truth and it changes over time.

observations.why: Builds upon the axiom with an architectural claim about how the system interprets truth.

evidence.quote: Git is not ideal for data, it is not designed for data. Dolt is designed for data.

observations.why: Unhedged technical assertion contrasting tools based on purpose.

evidence.quote: One of my operating theses is the telephone company always wins.

observations.why: Explicitly framed as an enduring operating thesis / strategic principle.

evidence.quote: The telephone company always wins because the telephone company sits in between. And it's impossible to disintermediate because they sit in between.

observations.why: Asserts the mechanics backing up his operating thesis.

evidence.quote: And so like the moat becomes over time, the more calls and decisions that you have ingested into a graph, the graph itself is the moat

observations.why: Asserts a core strategic theory of data moat and defensibility.

evidence.quote: I don't know, I'm feeling a little unsure of what I'm doing right at this point.

observations.why: Expresses overt uncertainty and hesitation regarding strategy and positioning.

evidence.quote: I think you should definitely apply to yc.

observations.why: Firm directive recommendation marked with an intensifier.

evidence.quote: I don't want to say I'm certain about these hypotheses. I'm not certain about these hypotheses.

observations.why: Explicit disclaimer of certainty regarding strategic hypotheses.
